breakdown.description: Fin efficiency greater than 1 is unphysical; efficiency is bounded by 1.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states that 'The fin efficiency must satisfy 0 < eta_f <= 1; the given value of 1.25 is physically invalid and must not be used.' It then correctly prescribes computing eta_f using the adiabatic-tip straight fin formula eta_f = tanh(mL)/(mL), which always yields a value in (0, 1]. This fully resolves the inconsistency of the unphysical eta_f = 1.25 and aligns with the ground truth.
